question: The line $\vec{r}=\vec{a}+\lambda(\hat{i}+p\hat{j}+\hat{k})$ makes an angle of $30^\circ$ with the plane $x+z=5$. Find all possible values of $p$.
explanation:
Step 1: Direction and normal vectors
The direction vector of the line is
$$\vec{b}=\hat{i}+p\hat{j}+\hat{k},$$
and a normal vector to the plane $x+z=5$ is
$$\vec{n}=\hat{i}+\hat{k}.$$
Step 2: Angle-between-line-and-plane formula
If $\phi$ is the angle between the line and the plane, then
$$\sin\phi=\frac{|\vec{b}\cdot\vec{n}|}{|\vec{b}||\vec{n}|}.$$
Step 3: Substitution of $\phi=30^\circ$
Here $\vec{b}\cdot\vec{n}=2$, $|\vec{b}|=\sqrt{p^2+2}$ and $|\vec{n}|=\sqrt{2}$. Therefore,
$$\frac{1}{2}=\frac{2}{\sqrt{2}\sqrt{p^2+2}}.$$
Step 4: Algebraic simplification
$$\sqrt{2}\sqrt{p^2+2}=4.$$
Squaring,
$$2(p^2+2)=16\Rightarrow p^2=6.$$
Step 5: Final result
Hence, the possible values are
$$p=\sqrt{6}\quad\text{or}\quad p=-\sqrt{6}.$$
